name: Yinlong
sum: Yinlong is a small bipedal ceratopsian from the Late Jurassic Shishugou Formation of Xinjiang, the earliest well-known member of the group.
wsnote: No length figure in the sources used.
holotype: Well-preserved skeleton with skull of a nearly adult animal found in 2004 — Shishugou Formation, Xinjiang, China.
biology: Small, primarily bipedal herbivore; skull deep and wide, without frill or horns, with a rostral bone.
author: Xu et al. 2006

sources.text: X. Xu, C. A. Forster, and J. M. Clark, J. Mo. 2006. A basal ceratopsian with transitional features from the Late Jurassic of northwestern China. Proceedings of the Royal Society of London B 273:2135-2140
